scope: Local native HOME tilde expansion in shell argument words and redirect targets; assignment and login-name expansion remain open.
implementation: Rust expands an initial unquoted bare tilde prefix from the current captured HOME without splitting, globbing, source reparse or host user lookup. Existing expanded byte limits apply before redirection opens. No persistence schema change.
